# Fixed native inputs

These JSON files are inputs to the Office UI/Host equivalence and self-import
regressions. They are retained byte-for-byte from the earlier checked corpora;
PPTX/DOCX/PDF/PNG output and timing reports are generated by the tests and are not
input baselines. The slide/document golden inputs are shared by the export and
self-import cases instead of retaining duplicate copies in verification folders.

The `../practical` artifact inputs retain the manually assembled #6 materials
consumed by the Office corpus scripts. They are not downloaded evidence outputs.

Generate fresh output after `npm ci` and `npm run fonts:fetch`:

```sh
node scripts/office/run-pptx-corpus.mjs test-results-office
node scripts/office/run-docx-corpus.mjs test-results-office-docx
E2E_SUITE=production npx playwright test tests/e2e/office-pptx-corpus.spec.ts tests/e2e/office-docx-corpus.spec.ts
```

The checked-in fixtures are sufficient for ordinary tests.
